playkitAuthor.instructions.sort.en: Enter items in the correct order. The server will shuffle them for players.
playkitAuthor.instructions.sort.zh-Hans: 请按正确顺序录入条目，服务端会为玩家打乱顺序。

playkitAuthor.instructions.match.en: Each entered left/right row is a correct pair. Players receive a shuffled right column.
playkitAuthor.instructions.match.zh-Hans: 每行的左、右两项组成正确配对，玩家看到的右侧条目由服务端打乱。

playkitAuthor.instructions.classify.en: Define categories, then assign every item to its correct category.
playkitAuthor.instructions.classify.zh-Hans: 先定义类别，再为每个条目指定正确类别。

playkitAuthor.compass.boundary.en: A direction is required. Compass alignment awards configured points only; it is not proof of arrival. Native sensor permission and device acceptance are separate.
playkitAuthor.compass.boundary.zh-Hans: 必须明确填写目标方位。罗盘对准仅按配置计分，不能作为到店凭证。原生传感器权限与真机验收是独立步骤。

playkitAuthor.shout.boundary.en: Participants must agree to microphone use and sustain the sound continuously. Consider the location and other people before choosing this task.
playkitAuthor.shout.boundary.zh-Hans: 参与者需要同意使用麦克风并持续发声。选择此玩法前，请考虑现场环境与周围的人。

playkitAuthor.balancePairs.en: Add blank rows to the shorter column
playkitAuthor.balancePairs.zh-Hans: 为较短的一列补充空白条目

playkitAuthor.previewBoundary.en: Author rehearsal only. No request is sent, no live session is created and no reward is awarded. Secret answers are removed from these player controls.
playkitAuthor.previewBoundary.zh-Hans: 仅供作者试用。不会发送请求、创建真实会话或发放奖励。此处的玩家控件已移除答案字段。

playkitAuthor.sensorPreviewBoundary.en: This shows the configured sensor task and its native controls. Hardware stays off in author preview; use an accepted device-testing configuration to measure real input.
playkitAuthor.sensorPreviewBoundary.zh-Hans: 这里展示配置的传感器任务与原生控件。作者预览中不启动硬件，真实输入需在获准的真机测试配置中验证。

playkitAuthor.presentation.focusedRequir.en: This game requires a dedicated screen. An inline selection must be changed before saving.
playkitAuthor.presentation.focusedRequir.zh-Hans: 此玩法需要独立页面，保存前请将内嵌选择改为独立页面。

playkitAuthor.validation.presentation.zh-Hans: 请选择受支持的呈现方式

playkitAuthor.validation.fullscreenOnly.en: This game cannot be embedded in the story
playkitAuthor.validation.fullscreenOnly.zh-Hans: 此玩法不能嵌入故事流

playkitAuthor.validation.row.en: Every item must have the expected object shape
playkitAuthor.validation.row.zh-Hans: 每个条目都必须符合对象结构

playkitAuthor.validation.id.en: Item IDs must be unique, 1–32 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens
playkitAuthor.validation.id.zh-Hans: 条目 ID 必须唯一，使用 1 至 32 位字母、数字、下划线或短横线

playkitAuthor.validation.label.en: Every item needs 1–40 UTF-16 units of text
playkitAuthor.validation.label.zh-Hans: 每个条目需填写 1 至 40 个 UTF-16 单位的文案

playkitAuthor.validation.image.en: An item image must use a valid HTTPS address
playkitAuthor.validation.image.zh-Hans: 条目图片需使用有效的 HTTPS 地址

playkitAuthor.validation.prompt.en: Enter a question of 1–200 UTF-16 units
playkitAuthor.validation.prompt.zh-Hans: 请填写 1 至 200 个 UTF-16 单位的题干

playkitAuthor.validation.sort.items.coun.zh-Hans: 排序需要 2 至 8 个条目

playkitAuthor.validation.match.left.coun.zh-Hans: 配对左列需要 2 至 6 个条目

playkitAuthor.validation.match.right.cou.zh-Hans: 配对右列需要 2 至 6 个条目

playkitAuthor.validation.match.sameCount.en: The matching columns must contain the same number of items
playkitAuthor.validation.match.sameCount.zh-Hans: 配对两列的条目数必须相同

playkitAuthor.validation.classify.bins.c.zh-Hans: 分类需要 2 至 4 个类别

playkitAuthor.validation.classify.items..zh-Hans: 分类需要 2 至 10 个条目

playkitAuthor.validation.classify.answer.en: Assign every item to an existing category, with no extra answers
playkitAuthor.validation.classify.answer.zh-Hans: 请为每个条目指定现有类别，并移除多余答案

playkitAuthor.validation.kicker.en: The heading must be at most 32 UTF-16 units
playkitAuthor.validation.kicker.zh-Hans: 标题不能超过 32 个 UTF-16 单位

playkitAuthor.validation.compass.bearing.en: Enter an integer direction from 0 to 359 degrees
playkitAuthor.validation.compass.bearing.zh-Hans: 请填写 0 至 359 度的整数方位

playkitAuthor.validation.compass.toleran.en: Compass tolerance must be an integer from 5 to 90 degrees
playkitAuthor.validation.compass.toleran.zh-Hans: 罗盘容差须为 5 至 90 度的整数

playkitAuthor.validation.compass.holdSec.en: Compass hold time must be an integer from 1 to 10 seconds
playkitAuthor.validation.compass.holdSec.zh-Hans: 罗盘保持时长须为 1 至 10 秒的整数

playkitAuthor.validation.compass.hint.en: The compass hint must be at most 60 UTF-16 units
playkitAuthor.validation.compass.hint.zh-Hans: 罗盘提示不能超过 60 个 UTF-16 单位

playkitAuthor.validation.compass.xp.en: Compass points must be an integer from 0 to 1000
playkitAuthor.validation.compass.xp.zh-Hans: 罗盘奖励分须为 0 至 1000 的整数

playkitAuthor.validation.shout.seconds.en: Continuous voice duration must be 5–300 seconds
playkitAuthor.validation.shout.seconds.zh-Hans: 持续发声时长须为 5 至 300 秒

playkitAuthor.validation.shout.xp.en: Voice challenge points must be an integer from 0 to 1000
playkitAuthor.validation.shout.xp.zh-Hans: 发声挑战奖励分须为 0 至 1000 的整数

templateAuthor.field.holdSeconds.zh-Hans: 连续保持，1 至 10 秒

templateAuthor.advancedScope.en: Seven Flutter scalar panels and five newer source-backed reasoning/sensor panels are available. Other sections are preserved, but unsupported enabled sections still block publishing.
templateAuthor.advancedScope.zh-Hans: 已提供七个 Flutter 参数面板和五个新增的推理／传感器配置面板。其他配置会保留，但启用未支持的配置仍会阻止发布。

playkitLegacy.scan.staticFallback.en: The returned overlay is shown as a regular image. No camera anchoring or AR placement is claimed.
playkitLegacy.scan.staticFallback.zh-Hans: 返回的叠加图以普通图片展示，不代表已贴合相机画面或完成 AR 放置。

playkitLegacy.scan.arGate.en: Plane and marker AR need an accepted renderer and asset configuration. The returned image remains available as the fallback.
playkitLegacy.scan.arGate.zh-Hans: 平面与图像识别 AR 需要已验收的渲染器和素材配置，当前仍可查看返回的图片。

playkitLegacy.music.boundary.en: Listening is optional. Playback does not submit completion or promise points.
playkitLegacy.music.boundary.zh-Hans: 可以自由聆听，播放不会提交完成状态，也不承诺奖励分。

playkitLegacy.silent.noWitnessCode.en: The service has not supplied a witness code
playkitLegacy.silent.noWitnessCode.zh-Hans: 服务端尚未提供见证码

playkitLegacy.window.authority.en: The server decides whether this time window is open. These are the configured clock labels, not a device-time unlock.
playkitLegacy.window.authority.zh-Hans: 是否开放由服务端决定。这里展示配置的时刻，不使用设备时间自动解锁。

playkitLegacy.window.subscribed.en: The source service reports a reminder subscription
playkitLegacy.window.subscribed.zh-Hans: 源服务显示已登记提醒订阅

playkitLegacy.window.providerGate.en: The source reminder uses WeChat subscription authorization. No equivalent native permission or subscription has been approved.
playkitLegacy.window.providerGate.zh-Hans: 源提醒依赖微信订阅授权，尚未批准等效的原生权限或订阅链路。

playkitLegacy.blind.instructions.en: Choose what you tasted. The answer stays on the server.
playkitLegacy.blind.instructions.zh-Hans: 选择你品尝到的选项，答案由服务端保管。

playkitLegacy.blind.tryAgain.en: That choice was not solved. You can choose again.
playkitLegacy.blind.tryAgain.zh-Hans: 这个选择尚未答对，可以重新选择。

playkitLegacy.name.audience.en: The name can be shown publicly and is checked by the service before it is saved.
playkitLegacy.name.audience.zh-Hans: 作品名可能公开展示，保存前会由服务端进行内容审核。

playkitLegacy.slow.emptyReadback.en: The server recorded the claim but returned no reveal text
playkitLegacy.slow.emptyReadback.zh-Hans: 服务端已记录领取，但未返回揭示文案

playkitLegacy.slow.ready.en: The server says this discovery can be claimed
playkitLegacy.slow.ready.zh-Hans: 服务端显示这次发现已可领取

playkitLegacy.slow.authority.en: Waiting and availability come from the server. Changing your device date cannot unlock this task.
playkitLegacy.slow.authority.zh-Hans: 等待天数和可领取状态由服务端返回，修改设备日期不能解锁任务。

playkitLegacy.silent.boundary.en: This clock is only a companion. It never proves a result, completes an order or awards points.
playkitLegacy.silent.boundary.zh-Hans: 这个计时器仅作陪伴展示，不作为结果凭证，不完成订单，也不发放奖励。
